There's one situation a prototype can't actually show me, so let me just confirm it in words — it's about **time passing between visits**.

Because the whole point is reliably finding your links *later*, I'm assuming that when you close the app and come back another day, everything is still exactly as you left it: your saved bookmarks, their tags and notes, your read-later marks, and your archive all persist — nothing is lost between sessions. This is your private personal collection, so only you see it.

> Is that right — **your bookmarks and all their organizing should be saved permanently and still be there whenever you return**?

And a related question so I capture the boundary correctly: for this first version, is it enough that your collection persists **in the browser you use it in**, or do you already need it to **follow you across multiple devices** (say phone and laptop)? Either is fine — I just want to know whether cross-device access is part of this first version or something for later.
